CustomField.formula:
IF (ISBLANK(Time_Lunch__c), "",
IF(HOUR(Time_Lunch__c) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(Time_Lunch__c)), TEXT(HOUR(Time_Lunch__c)-12)) & ":" &
IF (MINUTE(Time_Lunch__c) < 10, "0" + TEXT(MINUTE(Time_Lunch__c)), TEXT(MINUTE(Time_Lunch__c))) &
IF (HOUR(Time_Lunch__c) < 12, " AM", " PM"))
CustomField.label: Time Lunch Formula
